data.summary: Rules that redeploy units once both armies have deployed are resolved in this step, unless they say otherwise. Players alternate resolving them, the Attacker first. Units placed into **[strategic reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves)** during this step are left out of the total points value of all the units you hold there.

detail.timing: after both armies are deployed, unless a rule states otherwise
detail.strategicReservesPoints: placements into strategic reserves during this step are excluded from the strategic reserves points total
